{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_data = data[
    (data['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Confirm the number of filtered rows
num_filtered = len(filtered_data)
print(f'Number of completed non-QA orders: {num_filtered}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Channel revenue: {channel_revenue}')

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()
print(f'Best channel: {best_channel}')
print(f'Max revenue: {max_revenue}')

# Return values for evidence
num_filtered, channel_revenue, best_channel, max_revenue"}
